name: Ultra Waves (Quistis)
doc: Ultra Waves (Quistis' Blue Magic): the root and the controller - Quistis' casting animation, the four ring emitters around her, the screen warp, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag184_ultra_waves_quistis.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, grid and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: Quistis' casting animation, the four ring emitters around her, the screen warp, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the controller

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 25 vertices, 16 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Animation set
params.doc: The animation set it binds to its caster: body animations, sequence scripts, weapon animations ({count, offsets, end}, the game's count)

params.label: Particle colours
params.doc: its colour words (red, green, blue, the GPU code byte), picked in turn (64 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
